title: Dividend Provision of the Whole Life Insurance Contract: Options, Withdrawals and Partial Surrender of Additions
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance (participating tiers of Ashgrove).

## Entitlement

Dividends are not guaranteed. On tiers that are participating, the dividend declared by the Board for a policy year is credited on the anniversary ending that year, provided the policy is in force, paid-up or reduced paid-up on that anniversary. Extended term and lapsed policies earn none, and the Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life is non-participating.

## Options

The dividend is applied under the option in effect on the anniversary:

| Option | Application |
|---|---|
| Paid-up additions | The dividend buys paid-up additional face at the net single premium per 1,000 of paid-up insurance; the face bought is the cash amount divided by that net single premium, multiplied by 1,000, rounded to the cent |
| Accumulate | The dividend goes on deposit with Ashgrove; the former clause on how this option is applied is retired, as stated under Retired clause |
| Reduce premium | The dividend pays the next installment due; any excess is held toward later installments |
| Cash | The dividend is paid to the owner |

When no option was elected, the tier's default dividend option applies. The reduce-premium option is unavailable once the policy is paid up, in which case paid-up additions apply.

## Changing the option

A dividend option change is accepted only while the policy status is in force, paid-up or reduced paid-up, as shown on the system record of that policy. The new option applies from the next anniversary's dividend.

## Withdrawals and partial surrenders

- The owner may withdraw accumulations in cash by request, at least the tier's smallest accumulation withdrawal unless the whole balance is withdrawn.
- The owner may surrender paid-up additions for their cash value by signed request, at least the tier's smallest additions surrender in cash value. The cash value paid is the face surrendered multiplied by the paid-up additions cash value and divided by the paid-up additions face, rounded to the cent.
- On a contract that is not a modified endowment contract, a withdrawal or partial surrender is taxable only to the extent it exceeds the cost basis; on a modified endowment contract it is taxable first to the extent of the gain. Federal tax is withheld at the default withholding rate of the taxable part unless the owner elected no withholding.

## Retired clause

The former clause under which accumulations are left on deposit and credited interest at the declared accumulation rate on each anniversary, on the balance held for the whole policy year, is **no longer in force**, together with its interest figure of the balance times the declared rate. It is superseded by the current Ashgrove basis for the amount placed on deposit at an anniversary, for the interest credited on the deposit, and for the accumulations withdrawn when reduced paid-up insurance is elected.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- **Additions bought.** A dividend of 850.00 at a net single premium of 400.00 per 1,000 buys 850.00 divided by 400.00, times 1,000, that is 2125.00 of paid-up additions face.
- **Partial surrender.** Paid-up additions face 20000.00 with a cash value of 8000.00; surrendering 5000.00 of face pays 5000.00 times 8000.00 divided by 20000.00, that is 2000.00.
- **Option change status.** A request made while the policy is in force is accepted; the option takes effect for the dividend of the next anniversary.

superseded_clauses: accumulations are left on deposit and credited interest at dividend_accumulation_rate on each anniversary on the balance held for the whole policy year
